source_privacy: Original photos, full OCR transcripts, and sensitive search terms are private and excluded from Git/public preview.
ocr_scope: Supplementary rus+eng OCR against source-specific identifiers, health values and medical text; zero matches is not proof of perfect anonymization. Visual inspection also performed.
privacy_changes: Device status/navigation bars removed, identifiers/notifications erased
Name, dates, weight history, goals, health and activity values replaced with examples
Medication identity, dose and personal reminders replaced with neutral placeholders
Actual map and position removed entirely; schematic unidentifiable geometry only
Weight plot replaced with illustrative history; plan label wrapping repaired in demonstration asset only
limitations: Image editing may change small typography/geometry; these are edited demonstrations, never exact final or approved APK screenshots
No Android source changes, runtime verification, APK validation, physical-device or owner visual acceptance claimed
Fictional chart points/forecast are illustrations, not a validated health calculation
